QUIC keep-alive and timeout tests for connection state, final callbacks, and slot reuse.

# Purpose
This file is a QUIC connection timeout test program. It creates a client and a server `fd_quic_t` pair, connects them through a virtual pair, and uses callback functions such as `my_connection_new`, `my_handshake_complete`, and `my_connection_final` to track connection state changes. The test code advances a global `now` value and calls `fd_quic_service` to verify idle timeout handling, keep-alive behavior, explicit connection shutdown with `fd_quic_conn_let_die`, and reuse of connection slots after timed-out connections are removed. The [`main`](<#main>) function sets up the test environment, configures QUIC limits and timeouts, runs the test cases, and then releases all allocated resources.
